name: Ballymoney Wards 1985 (Raster)

references.label: Local Government (Boundaries) Order (Northern Ireland) 1984 (S.R. 1984 No. 208)
references.note: Made 18 Jun 1984 on the Local Government Boundaries Commissioner's report under section 50 of the Local Government Act (Northern Ireland) 1972, giving effect to it without modification; in force 15 May 1985 (1 Aug 1984 for election proceedings, 1 Apr 1985 for rates). Alters the boundaries of certain districts and the number, names and boundaries of wards; the districts are defined by the deposited maps. The districts whose boundaries moved were found by comparing Civgraph's 1973 and 1985 district layers.

references.label: Local Government (Boundaries) (Supplemental) Order (Northern Ireland) 1984 (S.R. 1984 No. 209)
references.note: Made 18 Jun 1984 under section 52 of the Local Government Act (Northern Ireland) 1972, alongside the Local Government (Boundaries) Order (Northern Ireland) 1984; in operation 15 May 1985, when it revoked the Local Government (Boundaries) Order (Northern Ireland) 1972 that the 1984 Order replaced.
